newsitem.title: UK: Brit Steel to implement share buy-back plan.
newsitem.headline: Brit Steel to implement share buy-back plan.

text.p: British Steel said on Thursday it intended to implement a share buy-back programme for which authority was granted by shareholders at its annual general meeting on July 24, 1996.
The share price of British Steel was ahead by 3-1/2 pence to 153p minutes after the announcement.
The steel giant did not mention what percentage of shares would be repurchased.

The buy-back statement follows the company's recent annual results which saw profits declining to 451 million stg from 1.08 billion in the previous year, mainly on the continuous rise of the sterling.
The company's brokers Cazenove & Co has been appointed to operate the buy-back programme.
